dialogue.origin: （こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.content: (Hello. Thank you for coming today. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はご相談に来てくださり、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢、性別、今日のご相談の内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 中2女子何もかもつまらなくて学校にい行きたくない
dialogue.content: I'm a girl in my second year of junior high. Everything feels boring, and I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。なるほど、学校のことで悩まれているのですね。どうしてそう感じるのか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. I see you're having a hard time with school. Could you tell me more about why you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 勉強好きなわけじゃないし休み時間も音楽気いいてるだけだし家にいても同じ
dialogue.content: I'm not into studying, and during breaks I just listen to music. It's the same even when I'm at home.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そんな気持ちだと、学校にいてもつまらないですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. Feeling that way, I can see how school would be boring.

dialogue.origin: どこにいても同じ
dialogue.content: It's the same wherever I am.

dialogue.origin: 休み時間は、お友達と話をしたりすることはありますか？
dialogue.content: During breaks, do you ever talk with your friends?

dialogue.origin: あんまりない音楽聴いてる
dialogue.content: Not really. I just listen to music.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ひとりで音楽を聴いているんですね。部活は何かやってますか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you listen to music by yourself. Are you in any school clubs?

dialogue.origin: なんか面白く無くなって辞めた
dialogue.content: It just stopped being fun, so I quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。もしよろしければ、どんなことが理由でやめたのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. If you're comfortable, could you share what led you to leave?

dialogue.origin: んーブラバンだったけどやりたい楽器買えなくて　みんないずれは自分の買うんだけど
dialogue.content: Hmm... I was in the brass band, but I couldn't get the instrument I wanted to play. Everyone eventually buys their own, you know.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。やりたい楽器があったけど、買うことができなくてやめることになったんですね。それは残念でしたね。やめなければならなくなったときは、どんな気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. So you had an instrument you wanted to play, but you had to quit because you couldn't buy it. That must have been disappointing. How did you feel when you had to quit?

dialogue.origin: どーでもいいって感じかな
dialogue.content: Kind of like, whatever.

dialogue.origin: ブラバンにはどれくらいいたんですか？
dialogue.content: How long were you in the brass band?

dialogue.origin: 1学期だけ
dialogue.content: Just for the first semester.

dialogue.origin: 一年の時の
dialogue.content: During my first year.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。辞める時は、ブラバンの人たちから、何か声がけはありましたか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me. When you quit, did anyone from the brass band say anything to you?

dialogue.origin: 楽器買ってもらえなくてやだったのは覚えてるけどそれ以外覚えてない
dialogue.content: I remember being upset that I couldn't get the instrument, but I don't remember anything else.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。あなたは。音楽にとても興味をお持ちだと感じますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I see. I get the sense you're very interested in music. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: ねー　リスカってスッキリするって聴いたんだけど　ほんと？
dialogue.content: Hey, I heard that cutting (self-harm) makes you feel relieved. Is that true?

dialogue.origin: やっても死ぬわけじゃないしちょっと興味ある
dialogue.content: It's not like I'd die from it, and I'm a bit curious.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。どこでそのようなことを聴いたのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Where did you hear something like that?

dialogue.origin: ネットで検索したらいくらでもまえ歌手が話してたのも聴いた
dialogue.content: If you search online, you can find tons of stuff. I also heard a singer talk about it before.

dialogue.origin: ほんとにスッキリするならやりたい痛くない？
dialogue.content: If it really makes you feel better, I want to try it. Doesn't it hurt?

dialogue.origin: ネットで見たんですね。身体を傷つけることになるから、痛くないというのはありえないな。
dialogue.content: So you saw it online. You'd be injuring your body, so there's no way it wouldn't be painful.

dialogue.origin: でもスッキリするんでしょ
dialogue.content: But it makes you feel better, right?

dialogue.origin: あなたはどう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 恐い気持ちもあるけどつまんないよりは刺激？になんのかなって
dialogue.content: I'm scared, but I was thinking it might be more stimulating than being bored.

dialogue.origin: 身体を傷つけて、傷跡も残る。場合によっては命にもかかわることになる行為だよ。
dialogue.content: It's injuring your body and can leave scars. In some cases it can even be life-threatening.

dialogue.origin: 傷はわたしに残るんだし誰も気にしないよ死ぬ気はないしね
dialogue.content: The scars will be on me, and no one cares anyway. And I'm not trying to die.

dialogue.origin: そのように思われるんですね。その傷を誰かにみられたらどうする？
dialogue.content: That's how you feel, I see. What would you do if someone saw the scars?

dialogue.origin: 見せなきゃいいじゃんとにかくスッキリしたいんだよ
dialogue.content: Then I just won't show them. Anyway, I just want to feel relieved.

dialogue.origin: 隠さなければならないものがずっと体に残るってどう思う？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about having something on your body that you have to hide forever?

dialogue.origin: タトゥーみたいなものって思えばたいしたことない
dialogue.content: If I think of it like a tattoo, it's not a big deal.

dialogue.origin: これから先に彼氏ができた時に、見せられる？
dialogue.content: If you have a boyfriend in the future, would you be able to show him?

dialogue.origin: あんま先のこと考えても仕方ない　友達もいないのに彼なんてできないし
dialogue.content: There's no point thinking that far ahead. I don't even have friends, so I won't have a boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: そうだね。先のことを考えてもしかたないね。でも、おうちの人がそれを見たらどう思うかなあ？
dialogue.content: You're right. There's no use thinking too much about the future. But I wonder, what would your family think if they saw it?

dialogue.origin: 忙しくて気づかないよ
dialogue.content: They're too busy to notice.

dialogue.origin: おうちの人とは、お話はしないの？
dialogue.content: Don't you talk with your family?

dialogue.origin: 病院で働いてるから夜勤とかもあるし　顔合わせること少ない
dialogue.content: She works at a hospital, so she has night shifts and stuff. We don't see each other much.

dialogue.origin: 病院で働いているんだね。医療にかかわる人は、家族の体の変化には敏感だと聞いたことがあるよ。
dialogue.content: So she works at a hospital. I've heard that people in the medical field are sensitive to physical changes in their family members.

dialogue.origin: わたしにはそうでもないよ暇ないから
dialogue.content: Not with me. She doesn't have time.

dialogue.origin: どうしてそう思うの？
dialogue.content: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: わたしが学校行っててもいってなくても多分気づかない。仕事してお金稼がないといけないから
dialogue.content: She probably wouldn't notice whether I go to school or not. She has to work and earn money.

dialogue.origin: そんなふうに感じるんですね。どうしてお金を稼がないといけないと思うの？
dialogue.content: I see that's how you feel. Why do you think she has to earn money?

dialogue.origin: 母子家庭だし楽器買えなかったのもお金ないって言われたからだし
dialogue.content: It's a single-mother household, and I was told we didn't have money, which is why I couldn't get the instrument.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。あなたが学校へ行っても行ってなくてもたぶん気付かないと思うのはどうしてですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What makes you think she probably wouldn't notice whether you go to school or not?

dialogue.origin: 夜勤とかもあって顔合わす時間がないから関心もないんじゃない？
dialogue.content: Because she has night shifts and things, we don't have time to see each other, so maybe she's just not interested?

dialogue.origin: お母さんともっと話をする時間があったらいいなと思いますか？
dialogue.content: Do you wish you had more time to talk with your mother?

dialogue.origin: 時間があればね。でもないから仕方ないとおもってる
dialogue.content: If there were time, yeah. But we don't, so I think it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: あ、兄帰ってきた。カップラーメンの場所聞かれてるから行かないと
dialogue.content: Oh, my brother's home. He's asking where the cup noodles are, so I have to go.

dialogue.origin: 行ってもいいかな？
dialogue.content: Is it okay if I go?

dialogue.origin: 忙しいところ、話をきかせてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you for taking the time to talk with me when you're busy.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそじゃぁね
dialogue.content: Thank you, too. Bye then.

dialogue.origin: あなたはお母さんに心配をかけたくないと思っている優しい娘さんですね。でも、お母さんに話をしてみてほしいな。お母さんも、きっと喜ぶと思うよ。また話を聴かせてね。
dialogue.content: You're a kind daughter who doesn't want to worry your mother. But I'd like you to try talking to her. I'm sure she would be happy, too. Please come talk to me again.

dialogue.origin: （今日はありがとうございました。これで終了とさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for today. We will now conclude the session.)

topic.sub: 学校に行きたくない気持ち
